name: library-monorepo
description: Book library take-home: Turborepo + pnpm monorepo with an Express/Prisma API, a React web app and a domain-agnostic AI layer.

scripts.eval: turbo run build --filter=@library/ai-eval... --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @library/ai-eval run eval
scripts.stack: docker compose -p library-monorepo-test stop && docker compose up --build -d --wait
scripts.stack:real: docker compose -p library-monorepo-test stop && docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env up --build -d --wait
scripts.stack:test: docker compose -p library-monorepo stop && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.test.yaml up --build -d --wait
scripts.eval:docs: turbo run build --filter=@library/ai-eval... --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @library/ai-eval run eval:docs
